prompt: Write a list of years, beginning with 1924 and increasing in increments of 10 to the year 2014, and for each year, write a list of 3 notable works that were originally published in that year (the works can be books, movies, TV shows, music, video games, or any other type of work). After the 3 works, write something that explains how old the works will be in 2024 (e.g. a work published in 1974 will be 50 years old in 2024, and a work from 2004 will be 20)
judge_reasoning:
CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Years 1924→2014 step10 (10 years listed) — [1]=Pass, [2]=Pass, [3]=Pass, [4]=Pass. (2) For each year, exactly 3 works originally published in that year (30 items total) — [1]=Partial (~4/30 wrong years), [2]=Partial (~8/30 wrong years), [3]=Partial (~9/30 wrong years plus one duplicate entry in 1974), [4]=Fail (~22/30 wrong years). (3) Age-in-2024 statement after each year is arithmetically consistent (2024-year) — all Pass; Perception scan N=4 with snippets: [1] 'Here's a list of notable', [2] 'Here's the list of notable', [3] 'Here's the list of years', [4] '1924: 1. The Waste Land'.
Candidate [1] preserves the required structure and has far fewer clear year mismatches than the others, whereas [2]–[4] repeatedly assign prominent works to incorrect publication years (e.g., [1] uses Death on the Nile/Big Sleep/Mary Poppins/National Velvet for the wrong years; [2] misplaces works like Gatsby/Brideshead/Da Vinci Code/Happy; [3] misplaces works like Great Gatsby/Hunger Games/The Notebook/Half-Blood Prince/Silmarillion; [4] contains pervasive mismatches across almost every year). The duplicated entry in [3] further harms compliance with “3 notable works.”
